# Mac Freeware

> Small, free and open-source (GPL-3.0) native macOS apps by Rafet SAPANCI, written in Swift and SwiftUI. They run on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and have English and Turkish interfaces. No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases.

## Apps

- [MacMonitor](https://macfreeware.github.io/macmonitor/): MacMonitor is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows live CPU, RAM and network speed, with per-core load, memory breakdown, top processes, network usage history, free disk space and a long battery history one click away. Free alternative to: A lightweight, free alternative to iStat Menus, Stats and MenuMeters when you only need CPU, memory, disk and battery at a glance. Requires macOS 13+. Download: https://gitlab.com/freeware2/macmonitor/-/releases/permalink/latest/downloads/MacMonitor.pkg
- [MacCalendar](https://macfreeware.github.io/maccalendar/): MacCalendar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar calendar with a dual world clock and country flags, a month view, quick notes for any day and more than 400 cities. Free alternative to: A free alternative to Itsycal, Dato and Clocker: a month calendar and a second time zone right in the menu bar. Requires macOS 13+. Download: https://gitlab.com/freeware2/maccalendar/-/releases/permalink/latest/downloads/MacCalendar.pkg
- [MacRAR](https://macfreeware.github.io/macrar/): MacRAR is a free, open-source, WinRAR-style archive manager for macOS: open, extract and create RAR, ZIP, 7Z and TAR archives, with a Finder right-click menu. Free alternative to: A free WinRAR alternative for the Mac, and an alternative to Keka, BetterZip and The Unarchiver. Requires macOS 15+. Download: https://gitlab.com/freeware2/macrar/-/releases/permalink/latest/downloads/MacRAR.pkg
- [MacZilla](https://macfreeware.github.io/maczilla/): MacZilla is a free, open-source, native FTP, FTPS and SFTP client for macOS in the spirit of FileZilla: two panes, tabs, a transfer queue, folder sync and a Site Manager. Free alternative to: A free, native alternative to FileZilla, Cyberduck and Transmit on the Mac. Requires macOS 14+. Download: https://gitlab.com/freeware2/maczilla/-/releases/permalink/latest/downloads/MacZilla.zip
- [MacExplorer](https://macfreeware.github.io/macexplorer/): MacExplorer is a free, open-source, Windows Explorer-style file manager for macOS: tabs, dual pane, real Cut and Paste, a preview pane, and SFTP and FTP right in the window. Free alternative to: A free alternative to Finder, Path Finder, ForkLift and Commander One for people who miss Windows Explorer on the Mac. Requires macOS 15+. Download: https://gitlab.com/freeware2/macexplorer/-/releases/permalink/latest/downloads/MacExplorer.zip
